purpose: Resource recovery only; no candidate tuning or outcome-based stopping. Preserve the exact verified fallback while retaining unopened final seeds.
health_inputs: The eight previously fixed CLI stress states plus the same eight complex TRAIN roots used by runtime.py; original public inputs and actions, baseline plan_cache=false.
health_recovery_gate: At workers=3, all 16 original actions reproduced, zero invalid/fallback/over-2s. Then test workers 1/3/6 on all 16 and a fresh interleaved full CLI capacity pilot before restarting a candidate experiment.

confirmation_after_recovery.original_partial_batch: retain all 273 completed tasks and charges, close without outcome inspection; never merge mixed-resource partial data into the fresh comparison

confirmation_gate: Same as original H3 confirmation: positive Astra macro and reliable full CLI to advance, otherwise original DARCL2. No additional candidates.
time_gate: Using 0.85 times the measured recovered full-CLI throughput, confirmation plus selection must finish before 08:25:10 UTC, and the frozen final comparison plus 45 minutes protocol/packaging must fit 11:25:10 UTC. Do not start if this fails.
no_recovery: Complete the explicitly allowed original-DARCL2 fallback delivery, with missing confirmation/final comparison and loaded-host concurrency limitation disclosed. Do not invent final samples or claim a negative DA2 comparison.
